start.title: Welcome to CrypTool 2 Web Edition
start.intro: Open a template to get going, start with an empty workspace or open an existing .cwm file.
start.newWs: Create a new workspace with the graphical editor
start.tutorial: View a tutorial video about CrypTool 2 on YouTube

about.title: About
about.text: CrypTool 2 Web Edition runs the CrypTool 2 workspace in your browser: the original plugins and templates are executed locally with WebAssembly, nothing is sent to a server.
about.notOfficial: This is a prototype of a browser port of CrypTool 2 and not yet a replacement for the desktop version.
about.source: Original CrypTool 2 source code on GitHub
about.license: CrypTool 2 is open source software under the Apache License 2.0.
about.fork: This version is built from the web edition fork on GitHub
exp.toggleTip: Shows components and templates that are not part of the CrypTool 2 release (Experimental folder). They may be incomplete or slow.
exp.tip: Experimental component: not part of the CrypTool 2 release
cmd.title: Commands
cmd.tip: Command palette (Ctrl/⌘+K): find commands, components and templates by typing
cmd.placeholder: Type a command, component or template…
drop.hint: Drop a workspace (.cwm, .json) or a picture here
drop.unsupported: "{0}" cannot be opened: only workspaces (.cwm, .json) and pictures can be dropped.
exec.pauseTip: Pause the run: no component starts until you continue or take a step
exec.stepTip: Start the next ready component (F10); starts the workspace paused if it is not running

offline.tip: Downloads all templates and the plugins' data files (about 100 MB), so that everything also works without a network connection. What you have used once is kept anyway.
offline.unavailable: Offline use is not available in this browser (no service worker).
view.minimapTip: Overview of the workspace; click or drag in it to move the view
view.timingsTip: Shows how often each component ran and how long it took (green = fast, red = the slowest)
